Loss report: gitlab -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.runner (only a platform label has a Woodpecker form (labels.platform); other labels are lost)
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell (Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image; a step with no shell from a GHA or GitLab source runs under bash there, so bash-only syntax fails when the image sh is dash)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.paths: doublestar glob (pattern **.md has a different meaning in doublestar than in the source; it is written as is)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/1 trigger.filter.paths: doublestar glob (pattern !src/docs/** has a different meaning in doublestar than in the source; it is written as is)
